questions.text: Explain the role of Bogue's compounds ($C_3S, C_2S, C_3A, C_4AF$) in the hydration and strength development of Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC).
Differentiate between Cast Iron, Wrought Iron, and Mild Steel based on carbon content, mechanical properties, and engineering applications. What are TMT and HYSD bars?
Describe the manufacturing of common burnt clay bricks (Preparation of clay, Molding, Drying, and Burning in Hoffman's/Bull's Trench Kiln).
Explain compressive strength test, water absorption test, and efflorescence test conducted on building bricks according to standard codes.
Describe standard laboratory tests for OPC: (a) Standard consistency using Vicat apparatus, (b) Initial and final setting times, (c) Soundness test using Le Chatelier apparatus.
Define Fineness Modulus (FM) of aggregates. Explain the bulking of fine aggregate (sand) and derive its practical significance in concrete batching.
Explain the structure of an exogenous tree with a neat cross-sectional diagram. Discuss various natural and artificial seasoning methods of timber.
What are the essential constituents of an oil paint (base, vehicle, pigment, thinner, drier)? Explain the functions and examples of each constituent.
What are the characteristics of a good building stone? Explain quarrying and dressing of stones, along with the Smith test and Acid test for durability.
Classify lime (Fat lime, Hydraulic lime, Poor lime). Explain the slaking, setting, and hardening of fat lime versus hydraulic lime.
What are the common defects in timber (knots, shakes, rind galls, dry rot, wet rot)? Describe timber preservation techniques (Creosote oil, ASCU treatment).
